name: cardinal
description: Connect GitHub Copilot CLI to Cardinal: telemetry to the Outcomes Dashboard + unified Cardinal MCP tools, with hooks that derive initiative name and type from the current branch and keep Cardinal Investigations and Storyboards in step with the session.
postInstallMessage: Run the cardinal-connect skill (or `python3 <plugin directory>/scripts/cardinal-connect` in your own terminal) to connect this machine to Cardinal, then start a new Copilot CLI session.
